| Category = Shrimp recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] medium [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]] with tails, peeled and deveined 
* Freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|Cornmeal]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] melted unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 3 tbsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Cayenne Hot Sauce|hot sauce]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], smashed and very finely [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut oil]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine butter, hot sauce, soy, and garlic. Set aside.
#Dip shrimp into lemon juice. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
#[[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] shrimp into cornmeal. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
#Heat oil to 375°F. [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] shrimp in batches until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] shrimp in butter mixture. Serve warm with blue cheese dressing, if desired.
